title: "a " = "a" is TRUE: a trailing space does not make a different string

source.quote: The Power BI engine automatically trims any trailing spaces that follow text data, but doesn't remove leading spaces that precede the data
source.supports: trailing spaces are dropped from stored text, leading spaces are kept

derivation: The engine treats text that differs only by trailing spaces as the same value: it trims them from the data it stores and groups 'Dylan Williams' with 'Dylan Williams '. Taking = to follow the same equivalence, "a " equals "a".
alternative: The documented trimming is of stored text data. A literal in an expression is not stored data, and no source says that = ignores trailing spaces. If it does not, the two strings differ by one character and the result is FALSE.
notes: No source covers scalar comparison of strings with trailing spaces; this is the least supported case in the folder. The column case is strings/trailing-space-is-trimmed-in-a-column.
